name: fire-hydrant
description: A real-world object as a 3D model, judged on a valid GLB, real-world size, triangle budget and a clean viewer.

input.subject: A classic cast-iron pillar fire hydrant, painted red with slightly worn paint: a domed bonnet with a pentagonal operating nut on top, a barrel body with a rim near the top, two side hose outlets with caps and pentagonal nuts, one larger front pumper outlet with cap, a base flange with 6 bolts, standing on the ground. Real size about 0.75 m tall.
